description: Sainte Chapelle — Colore: Urban violet & gold texture Collezione: Colourismo Codice: 5725 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 70 cm × 37 cm Toni: Purple Once the royal chapel of the Kings of France, SAINTE CHAPELLE in Paris is a colorful and light-filled Gothic marvel worth the visit. Inspired by the unique textiles housed in the chapel, SAINTE CHAPELLE is shockingly modern for a pattern with its roots in medieval times. The random and electric line work seems to build toward an abstract topography or perhaps the melodic sound waves of an early hymn.
